name: EXP
usage: Experience gained from battle. It shows how far you've come.
description: Good job. Keep it up and get stronger. As long as you don't give up, your efforts will pay off in the end.

name: Drill Plan
usage: A plan used for tactical drills. Use it on the operation interface to simulate a battle so you can make plans accordingly.
description: Haste makes waste. For Rhodes Island, every operation has the potential for a loss of life. Therefore, it is wise to drill before actual combat, long before we run into an enemy ambush.

name: Credit

description: Credit holds communities together and stands as a symbol of social stability. Sometimes it's even more valuable than money, so do please cherish it.

name: Sanity
usage: The mental capacity to remain self aware, draw up plans, and execute them.
description: 'What is it that distinguishes us from this land? Our breath, or feeling? Or life and death?'

name: Drone

description: Drones used for construction. They are controlled by the Rhodes Island Logistics Department. Without them, Operators would have to wait 10 times as long to get base housing.

name: Preregister to get 1 of 4 Operators randomly

description: Who will it be? Can't wait!

name: Event Crystal
usage: A topological model of aggregated information. Can be used to rebuild past events.
description:
An auxiliary function of Rhodes Island's intelligence processing system. After extracting effective intelligence from a mass of information, the system is able to recreate images of past events. Information extracted through crystallization is typically of greater importance.
Its synthesis into optical disc form is simply for easier understanding by the layperson.

name: Valid Intelligence Unit
usage: A basic unit of the Rhodes Island Intelligence Processing System, used to advance intel-gathering efforts.
description: Whether it's providing mission feedback, collecting spoils, analyzing materials, facilitating communications, or streamlining operations, Rhodes Island's efficient intelligence system continues to collect complex data from a vast array of actions and operations in order to provide the best course of action. For those unfamiliar to the mechanisms of this black box, just looking at the results will suffice.

name: Top Tier Penguin Medal
usage: Collecting medals issued by Emperor himself? Probably a good idea.
description: A luxurious, but completely meaningless, golden medal created by the most esteemed goldsmiths in Lungmen. You'll be hard pressed to find anything more limited than this in all of Terra. It's clearly a cup, but still called a medal, and it symbolizes the highest praise of the Emperor. Each sip is worth a thousand bucks, but don't use it to make hot coffee!

description: The Rhodes Island Logistics Departmen issued this meal voucher during an event as an incentive to complete a series of missions. During the trial period, it will be distributed according to the number of missions completed or to operation results.

name: Anonymous Tags
usage: These ID tags are generally intact, with only part of the text worn out. The Scar Market looks favorably upon this good fortune.
description: The major problem facing Kazdel's metalworking industries is that because metallic resources are mostly used for killing soldiers instead of remembering them, the rate of soldier deaths almost outpaces the ability to produce identification tags for them. This tragic scarcity has created a ripe market for perverse collectors.

name: Best-selling Peterheim Cookies
usage: Sold exclusively at Peterheim Middle School and all the rage among students, can be exchanged for various supplies.
description:
Snack bags usually are not a very effective way to preserve the integrity of their contents, so it's hard to find one with a complete cookie inside.
Though a bit fragmented, the overall appearance is cute enough, and the flavor is still uncompromised.

name: Aristocrat's Antique Aureus
usage: An antique currency that is still in circulation in Wolumonde; Can be used to exchange for rewards at the August Fair.
description: The original owners of these antique coin have long departed from this remote land. However, the descendants of these decorated nobles still demanded Wolumonde's respect, and thus they passed into law the ability to circulate these coins for the purpose of satisfying their vanity.

description: Grip this document within your hands as if the distinctive laws of Leithanien never wavered. But, this illusion has long been shattered by the tragedy unfolding before your eyes in Wolumonde - delve deep into the mines, woods, and unclaimed vales, and bring justice to the perpetrators.

name: Mechanical Parts
usage: Widely-used mechanical parts in Zumama's tribe, can be exchanged for various supplies.
description: Originally seen only in Zumama's tribe, these eventually scattered throughout various places in the rainforests and wilds. Each one seems imaginative to the point of defying the laws of physics, but falls short of the industrial standards of any country.

description: Allows you to blur the boundary between fact and fiction, seeing things that you could not see before. Of course, this is the culprit behind your adventures.

name: Delicious Honey Biscuit
usage: A traditional Minosian food made from starch and fructose. Used to obtain rewards from the Honey Biscuit Castle.
description: Ceobe's favorite food. She is willing to part with anything in exchange for these.

name: Discarded Clock Dial
usage: An old, broken piece of a clock that can be exchanged for supplies at the weekend yard sale. Someone will want it.
description: A once treasured clock, now reduced to nothing more than a broken dial with some small value only to collectors. You find things like this in abandoned houses. A clock silently keeping the time can be priceless, or worthless. The hour hand on the dial is stuck in place, vainly trying to turn.

name: Mieszko Sports Securities

description: A couple blond Fortes are selling gold pieces of paper at three times the stated price. This voucher can be used to buy aid packages for competition knights in the arena, or as a bankroll to bet on, but be prepared to pay more than the number printed on it. A piece of paper, a huge sum, a knight's life of honor and shame.

description: Holy Statue Fragments telling of all sorts of damage lie forgotten in every nook and cranny of the monastery, each shard unlike any other. These may never again piece together to form the complete image of a saint with a gun, but there are always those hanging onto hope.
obtain: Event Stage drop, Event mission reward

name: Sheet Music

description: The notes scribbled on the staff are jumbled and disorderly. Only the composer himself can, at a glance, make out the soul hidden therein.
obtain: Event Stage drop, Event mission reward

name: Guiding Figurines
usage: A crude carving left behind by the hunters. Wooden figures with indistinct features reach forth an arm, pointing to caves stockpiled with food, remedies, and tools.
description: So that others may more easily find supplies hidden in the forest, the hunters have made simple waymarkers. Be sure to restock some too after you avail of them, for the trees know all.

name: Monthly Card Exchange Permit
usage: Enables activation of Monthly Card privileges.
description: With an eye to negotiability and convenience, several new permits have risen to the task, and this just so happens to be one of them.

name: Mysterious Reagent
usage: The latest innovation of Rhine Lab's Energy Section. Collect enough and exchange with the Laboratory Recycling Depot for goods.
description: Very sensitive to neural activity, and can replace some of the functions of traditional Arts Units. In the Rhine Lab Defense Section's laboratory supplies management handbook, this test reagent's hazard and confidentiality levels are both listed at maximum.
obtain: Event Stage drop, Event mission reward

usage: Looks good for padding outdoors thermal equipment, but seems to have little use in the current season. The young girl at 'White Volcano' has an inexplicable love for bizarre wool like this, and will surreptitiously trade you goods from the shop for it. N.B.: DO NOT let her big brother know!
description: Soft, insulating, and highly absorptive, it might look extremely delicious, but please don't start eating it like cotton candy.
obtain: Event Stage drop, Event mission reward

obtain: Event Stage drop, Event mission reward

name: Data Blackbox
usage: Used to perform Data Iteration on Limiter Units.
description: An encrypted data block. Always remember, the conversion of information often entails unavoidable wear. Make good use of your information storage devices, but do not depend on them.

name: Photocopies of 'Stranger Things'
usage: Photocopies of a gaudy magazine, the contents preposterous, yet well-loved by Durin far and wide. Can be used at the Leaping Gloompincer Market to trade with the Durin for supplies.
description: The pages retain handwriting of all shapes and sizes, the amount even serving to tell you how often the magazine's changed hands. Most of it is meaningless scrawls, but flashes of wisdom are scattered throughout.
obtain: Event Stage drop, Event mission reward

name: Sami Impressions Furniture Pack I
usage: Obtain the furniture belonging to the two sets 'Dreamland Signposts' and 'Words of Nature' in the 'Sami Impressions' furniture series.
description: A Sami forest cabin recreated based on Magallan's notes and the supplementary reports from other operators who participated in the expedition. Quiet and simple, as things have always been.

name: Sami Impressions Furniture Pack II
usage: Obtain the furniture belonging to the two sets 'Life in the Forest' and 'Fireside Twitters' in the 'Sami Impressions' furniture series.
description: A Sami forest cabin recreated based on Magallan's notes and the supplementary reports from other operators who participated in the expedition. Quiet and simple, as things have always been.

name: Shoddy Fuel
usage: Combustibles salvaged from Davistown and its environs. Practically worthless for heat, and produces way too much smoke, but fuel is fuel and there's an old worker by the energy tower who'll trade goods from the mine for it.
description: Plastics, paper, wood... even scrapped Originium circuitry. Their only commonality is that they all burn when thrown in the power plant, and provide the plate with just that much more heat.
obtain: Event Stage drop, Event mission reward

description: A flickering, glinting fragment. A light so that you no longer fear the dark as you walk dauntlessly on through the thorns.
obtain: From event-exclusive drops and event missions

name: Experimental Dataset
usage: Stores operation data from the Formulative Battlerealm. Accumulate to advance Cogitative Diving Evaluation progress.
description: 'WARNING! Please refrain from undue perception of/empathy with simulation products, or subsequent generation of false data may lead to irreversible mental damage.'

name: Die Klänge von den Erinnerungen
usage: Leaves that fall on the streets of Zwillingstürme. Missing phrases of music can be found on them from time to time. Give them to tune seekers at concerts and be rewarded with the gift of music.
description: Memories of the past are scattered across the ancient capital of Leithanien, carried by broken passages of music. Like today's Leithanien, they will need be tuned before they can be heard.
obtain: Event Stage drop, Event mission reward

name: Lessing's Folder
usage: A folder storing personal notes. Lessing is obtained the first time this item is obtained, and can improve Lessing's Potential thereafter.
description: Several proverbs are written on the paper with tidy, print-like handwriting. The pen has penetrated the paper in a few places. There are also a few scribbles about things that need to be done.

name: Burdenbeast Blind Box
usage: Burdenbeast Blind Boxes—such a smash hit, Onboard Services ran out of stock for a time. That means this batch couldn't have come sooner, and the train attendants will be delighted to trade other goods for it.
description:
Blind boxes from the cultural industries in collaboration with 'BangBang Burdenbeast.' Collect all nine, including a limited-edition secret burdenbeast.
NOTE: Pray faithfully to the newly erected Kjeragandr statue, and your odds of drawing the secret one go up!
obtain: Event Stage drop, Event mission reward

name: Spicy Bottletree Sap
usage: Extremely spicy and fantastically invigorating, with a deep velvet flavor fresh bottletree sap can't hope to match. And the upside of not chronically ruining your body like hard liquor would. Give it to wild sandbeasts, and you might end up trading for their stashed curios.
description: Bottletree sap naturally fermented in the abdomens of tree-hanging Originium slugs, celebrated by man and adored by sandbeasts. Still, how the beasts get the sap when they can't climb trees is one of Rim Billiton's great mysteries. Are there feral barreners helping them? Can't be...

name: Prosperity Point
usage: A voucher that can be exchanged for rewards at 'Expansional Rewards'.
description: Each bead of sweat shed upon the barren ground will one day bear witness to the prospering of Terran civilization.

name: Arsalan Furniture Collection I
usage: Obtain the furniture belonging to the 'Arakeeshtu Jungle' and 'Narutabatim Alkalies' sets in the 'Arsalan Travel Tent' furniture series.
description: When the region's so close to the foehn hotlands, furnishings like these in Arsalan add a precious hint of comfort to your room.

name: Arsalan Furniture Collection II
usage: Obtain the furniture belonging to the 'Eqlumuy Oasis' and 'Traditions' sets in the 'Arsalan Travel Tent' furniture series.
description: When the region's so close to the foehn hotlands, furnishings like these in Arsalan add a precious hint of comfort to your room.

name: Sky Pole
usage: An agricultural drone developed by the Tianshi Bureaus, which people occasionally leave lying in the fields after they malfunction. If you pick any up, you can exchange them for goods at Shennong Market.
description: The newest fruit borne of the Dahuang Tianshi Bureau's research. Simple to control, resiliently mobile. Sample-taking and soil monitoring are among its many functions. Naughty children occasionally make off with them to use in 'fowl fights.'
obtain: Event Stage drop, Event mission reward

description: The Procurement Department's reconnected with its suppliers, and replenished stocks of initially limited pieces of furniture! Give your thanks to Closure!

name: Galería Stamp Card
usage: A card for the Galería stamp rally. The more stamps, the more prizes you get. Despite each and every card bearing the limited-daily ultra-rare secret stamps, Reynell will still gladly exchange them for goods. In his words, 'my small token of respect to our anonymous seal-forger supreme.'
description: Upon seeing these cards, Tecno indifferently thumbs at a row of halved radishes in the corner of her workshop, each cross-section dyed through in seal ink and ready to go.
obtain: Event Stage drop, Event mission reward

name: Raw Sugar Lumps
usage: A 'hard currency' aboard Babel. Save up enough to spare, and the nice Vampire lady down by the Engineering Team will trade for some scarcities you'll appreciate.
description: Crude sugar cubes of mechanized make, a Babel wartime supply ration. Provides soldiers with ample energy and a hint of sweetness.
obtain: Event Stage drop, Event mission reward

name: Emergency Inhibitor
usage: A new formulation from Rhodes Island's Medical R&D, capable of temporarily suppressing the exacerbation of Oripathy in Catastrophe- or battlefield-level Originium zones. THIS DRUG PLACES IMMENSE STRAIN ON THE BODY. USE WITH CAUTION.
description: WARNING: For best results, administer via peripheral IV. In case of first-aid, can attempt via CVC. If shock ensues after first dose, second IV may be administered within 5-7 minutes (repeat dose). EACH DOSE COULD BE THE KEY TO SAVING A LIFE IN THE FIELD. MAKE GOOD USE OF THEM.

name: Memento
usage: Leave your sweat in the stadium. Come home with camaraderie.
description: As you collect Mementos, so does Hype. Reach certain Hype levels to receive rewards.

name: 'Emergency Supplies' Blueprint Chip
usage: Microchip that holds a large number of blueprints, which can be printed at the Materianomicon Moderatrix.
description: 'Emergency Supplies' Blueprint Chip that contains nearly a thousand ready-to-print blueprints, including survival necessities and equipment for experiments and creative activities. Do not neglect exploration and expression, no matter how dire the circumstances, for the stagnation of the mind and numbing of the spirit is akin to death.
obtain: Event Stage drop, Event mission reward

description: A large piece of slag that was ejected from the Soul Furnace for unknown reasons, which shattered into pieces when bombarded by the airship. It contains trace amounts of Originium and Oriron, but extraction is extremely difficult.

usage: Obtain the furniture belonging to the two sets 'Melancholy of Dust' and 'Unending Omens' in the 'Memories of the Souls' furniture pack.
description: A room based on what the storytellers saw as they traversed the strange tales. The Logistics Department designer brought their entire imagination to bear, but the storytellers still think the furnishings lack the odd magnificence of the real deal.

name: Memories of the Souls Furniture Pack II
usage: Obtain the furniture belonging to the two sets 'Reborn in a Dream' and 'Chronological Eddies' in the 'Memories of the Souls' furniture pack.

description: A tourist souvenir from the City of Radiance. It is said that artificers can turn them into large gemstones. 'A padishah once ordered all the gems accumulated in his palace over a thousand years to be ground into fine grains of sand and scattered at the bottom of the garden pond, just so that the citizens could share in the radiance.' - Exhibit label on a mummy in the museum
obtain: Event Stage drop, Event mission reward

name: 'Expeditioners' Redemption Point
usage: Can be exchanged for the corresponding event stage reward.
description: Rhodes Island issues special reward points as an incentive to field operators dispatched to the base building operation in Szubat-Arsalan. These points can be used to redeem important supplies.
obtain: Limited-time Event Missions, Daily Event Missions

name: Daily Recipe
usage: A daily recipe waiting to be sent to Senshi's Dungeon Diner. If it's nutritionally balanced, you'll get a prize. If you're not sure which ingredients go with which, you can ask Matterhorn, Gummy, or Hibiscus.
description: A reminder for certain operators, especially Kay: The meals recommended in the cookbook are FULL meals! Stop asking if they're just snacks already!
obtain: Event Stage drop, Event mission reward

name: Attainment Point
usage: Can be exchanged at Breakthrough Milestones for rewards.
description: Special memorabilia of Rhodes Island Engineering Department make. Apparently, the Engineering op who designed it took inspiration from a board game that's been all the rage at Rhodes Island.

description: The Procurement Department's reconnected with its suppliers, and replenished stocks of initially limited pieces of furniture! Give your thanks to Closure!

name: 'Nay!'
usage: Every respectable citizen has the right to oppose Parliament's public proposals, and these emblems are Parliament's acknowledgment of said right. But rumor has it that some civil servants at the Office of Proposed Resolutions will secretly trade goods for this valuable right?
description:
An emblem personally gifted by the Madam Speaker for outstanding behavior during battle or reconstruction. Anyone can use them as valuable tokens of opposition during the notice periods of the proposals deciding Londinium's future.
Note that Parliament strictly forbids the trading of this honor!
obtain: Event Stage drop, Event mission reward

description: The anonymous sender calls themselves 'Il Signore del Carnevale'. It is unclear if this title is a threat or in jest. The dark red soaking the paper isn't blood, but rather a fragrant wine, which seems to say that this invitation was born alongside Carnevale itself.
obtain: Event Stage drop, Event mission reward

name: Stronghold Credits
usage: Can be exchanged for all sorts of supplies in Stronghold Protocol.
description: Medals prepared by Rhodes Island's workshop for operators participating in Stronghold Protocol. Magnetic. Apparently, if you gather enough of them, you can make a fortress out of chess pieces.
obtain: Event Stage drop, Event mission reward

description: Beverage made from chopped saltfin viscera and fermented with microorganisms from the underground rivers beneath the Salt Flat. The stench is both invigorating and tear-inducing. And as for its other properties... 'Has anyone told that idiota in the kitchen that you don't need to add any goddamn salt to a saltfin?!'
obtain: Event Stage drop, Event mission reward

name: Point Card
usage: A reward for first clearing stages which can be used to buy prizes at the Exchange Counter; subsequent reclears will not reward more.
description: The cards might be small, but get enough of them and you can trade them in for big prizes!

description: Fragrant meals fear not alleys deep. While invisible to the eye on most days, there is a faint aroma lining the streets, at least until it hits you face-first in front of the restaurant it leads to. You need only follow the scent of food to paint a grand picture of Baizao's streets.

usage: A crystal of blood left behind in the battlefield ruins. It is said that if you place it in a deserted nook where roses bloom, when the twin moons are at their brightest, the fortunate will find some unexpected presents waiting for them come daybreak.
description: A shattered yet still brilliant crystal shaped like a petal, often seen among death-blackened scorched earth. They are ripples left behind by traveling Canoes, engraved with the final memories and emotions of those who passed away.

description: A certificate of participation in Rhodes Island's Icebreaker Games. 'Leave your sweat in the stadium. Come home with camaraderie.'

name: Broken Originium Lamp
usage: A damaged Originium lamp found in the Dark Woods. Once Na Saoirsí's supply issues were resolved, the citizens spontaneously decided to organize, taking out the only supplies they had on hand to recover these relics of the war.
description: One tradition Tarans brought back is wearing an Originium lamp at their hips. Once, people would take them into the Dark Woods, but now those bodies have been scattered by the wind. Not even shadows are left, only shattered lamps.
obtain: Event Stage drop, Event mission reward

name: Super! Best! Boss Medal
usage: Looks to be made from expensive metals, and can be exchanged for LMD.
description: Exusiai suddenly remembered her promise to exchange those medals today. After checking the number of 'Best Boss' medals you have, she skirted around the old rules and gave you this one.

name: 'Courage' Badge
usage: Communicators made by Raidian in the shape of pin badges. Retrieving them can help reduce interference on the comms network, and they can be traded at Closure's for all sorts of supplies.
description: To help calm the children anxious about leaving the landship, Raidian made these pin badges with paging and messaging functionalities, encouraging them to keep on smiling and stay in contact. After hearing about them, many operators asked her for some, recording words of encouragement on them before hiding them all over prior to the evacuation.

name: Rhodes Island Supply Crate
usage: Contains an Emergency Sanity Sampler and some Rhodes Island Supplies.
description: A materials supply crate issued alongside Sanity samplers, giving you a random material as you restore your Sanity.

name: Grand Duel Fireworks
usage: One of the more expensive Duel Channel gifts, and can be exchanged on the website for material rewards, with free shipping and home delivery.
description: Apparently, using it can send a fullscreen fireworks effect along with a message to the entire Duel Channel. But what the richie-riches who break the TOS to spam them in public chat all day might not know is that they can be blocked with a click of a button on the website.

The first pacifiers to receive them wandered off through the Shrine in their confusion, leaving countless babes to suffer restless nights. If you are able to return them to their posts, the beleaguered nurturers will be happy to give gifts as thanks.
description: A pacifier soaked in saliva, with a miniature halo atop it. The child who threw it away is now wailing incessantly. Guide the way for the lost pacifier, and it will return to the child's side.
obtain: Event Stage drop, Event mission reward

name: 'Caution! Wet Floor!'
usage: Can be exchanged at Breakthrough Milestones for rewards.
description: An ordinary floor sign. After being used to denote acceleration points in stool racing competitions, operators interested in these competitions have become rather fond of it, eventually turning it into a collectible.

description: What is it, really? A ghost? A prop? A hallucination? Somebody's Friedkin pet? Nobody knows. Miss.Christine simply waves her twin tails as she languidly basks in the sunlight.
obtain: Event Stage drop, Event mission reward

description: A small object on the cusp of becoming a geist, taking advantage of humanity's inattention to trundle about. Pranks on the street corner, odd sounds from the depths of stoves... A strange air permeates the town.

name: Special Operator Battle Record
usage: A device that stores battle videos of Special Operators. Gives Special Operators a certain amount of EXP.
description:
Special Operators do battle in extremely complex environments with highly dynamic conditions, and recording them is equally difficult. But if it ends up helping out in some future battle, it will all be worth it.
This collection comes with a special 'Interesting Highlights' page.

name: Performer Meeting Chuusen-ken
usage: A ticket distributed by a talent agency, which can be exchanged for entry into a lottery. After a certain incident, they were the hottest item at the Vintage Bazaar for a while, and could be traded for nearly anything.
description: A lottery ticket, the prize being admission to a certain performer's 'graduation' farewell concert. While the event was officially canceled, it is still in private circulation among fans, a memento of a turning point in her career.
obtain: Event Stage drop, Event mission reward

name: Idle Gossip
usage: Used at the Soudanshitsu to start business for the day. The juicy stories you hear every day all start with a chat, after all.
description: Fragmentary words from the streets. They may seem useless, but they hide threads leading to all sorts of secrets. To those who know how to make use of them, even the smallest whisper of gossip can be a stepping stone to business.

name: Carefully-Prepared Tasting Set
usage: A carefully-prepared tasting set. Can be exchanged for LMD.
description: This is not the type of gift you can simply buy from a luxury store. This is a selection of drinks chosen based on her own tastes and what she thinks you will like, hand-poured bottle by bottle before being carefully sealed. In consideration for the nature of your work, there is also a bottle of sarsaparilla, 100% alcohol-free.

obtain: Event Stage drop, Event mission reward

name: Fantasies of the Garden Furniture Pack I
usage: Obtain the furniture belonging to the two sets 'Pavilion of the Rising Sun' and 'Balcony of Warm Scents' in the 'Fantasies of the Garden' furniture pack.
description: A room whose decor was inspired by the experiences of Leizi and the others in the Garden of Grotesqueries. Every tree, rock, lantern, and curtain within the Garden has been collected, curated, and brought back by Yi from his travels across the entire country. The world is full of treasures, but lacks people of discernment.

name: Fantasies of the Garden Furniture Pack II
usage: Obtain the furniture belonging to the two sets 'Tower of Breezes' and 'Chamber of Departing Fowlbeasts' in the 'Fantasies of the Garden' furniture pack.
description: A room whose decor was inspired by the experiences of Leizi and the others in the Garden of Grotesqueries. Every tree, rock, lantern, and curtain within the Garden has been collected, curated, and brought back by Yi from his travels across the entire country. The world is full of treasures, but lacks people of discernment.

name: Resource Point
usage: Credits derived from total resources, which can be used to obtain rewards from Closure.
description:
Rhodes Island was not built in a day, but we build it up day by day.
'For Rhodes Island.'

name: Training Handbook
usage: Can be used to increase Operator training level in Rebuilding Mandate.
description: The most important things in the Frontier Outposts are courage, perseverance, and humility. Live, learn, produce.

name: Skill Handbook
usage: Can be used to increase Operator skill level in Rebuilding Mandate.
description: Building and producing is no less a chore than fighting and killing. Remain vigilant and work together.

name: Strategic Beacon
usage: Can be used to apply Construction Strategies in Rebuilding Mandate.
description:
Virtual marker with Closure's crypto-signature. The quantity deployed is carefully calculated, ensuring that aid provided by Rhodes Island HQ is utilized efficiently.
'More interesting than a plain paper production plan, don't you think?'

name: Vanguard Advancement Token
usage: Can be used to promote Operators in Rebuilding Mandate.
description: Token that represents Elite Vanguard Operators, signifying that the holder has earned recognition for their production work at the Frontier Outposts.

usage: Can be used to appoint Operators in Random Appointment.
description: Packaged ore sample extracted from the center of an Originium vein. It is an acceptable substitute for refined Originium fuel when refining facilities are not available.
obtain: Resource Gathering; Urgent Targets; Frontier Outposts: , Leader Enemies

name: Refined Core
usage: Can be used to appoint Operators in Specialized Appointment.
description: Obtained by refining Packaged Cores. Difficult to obtain, and typically used to launch new production bases.

name: Elite Advancement Token
usage: Can be used to promote Operators in Rebuilding Mandate.
description: Token that represents Elite Operators, signifying that the holder has earned recognition for their production work at the Frontier Outposts.

name: Dream Puzzle Pieces
usage: A piece of a dream-shaped puzzle, dazzling and beautiful. You found these strewn across the floor when you came to the Castle. Now, be patient, gather them together, and see the wondrous scenes you bring to life once more.
description: No matter its beauty, a dream is but a dream, destined to fade from memory in time. It is hence that the masters of the Castle of Dreams have made a museum to hold onto these vanishing dreams, storing them in the manner of precious works of art. Each master has their own tastes, so take care not to offend with what you give them.

name: Special Redemption Point
usage: Can be exchanged for the corresponding event stage reward.
description: Rhodes Island issues special redemption points as an incentive to field operators. These points can be used to redeem important supplies.

name: Thank-You Celebration Recruiting Supplies
usage: HR resource pack for recruitment, allowing a large number of Operators to be recruited via public channels.
description: Events equal marketing, so it is only natural that HR would be busy during this time. You owe ■■■ one.

name: Participation Certification - S2
usage: As you collect Participation Certificates, so does Hype. Reach certain Hype levels to receive rewards.
description: A certificate of participation in Rhodes Island's Icebreaker Games. 'Leave your sweat in the stadium. Come home with camaraderie.'

name: Icebreak Points
usage: Can be exchanged for the corresponding event stage reward.
description: The Icebreaker Games have the spotlight today thanks to your wholehearted support.

name: Flint
usage: An indispensable tool in the wilderness of Ursus, lighting the flame that drives back the cold and darkness. Fire is banned in the mines, but that has not stopped the miners from sharing flints.
description: The sound of hitting flint fades into the vast snow. The darkness is boundless, with only a tiny speck of flame to illuminate it, quietly flickering and melting the ice and snow, and waiting for the sun to rise again.

name: Rhodes Island Supply Crate
usage: Contains an Emergency Sanity Sampler and some Rhodes Island Supplies.
description: A materials supply crate issued alongside Sanity samplers, giving you a random material as you restore your Sanity.

name: Invito Mistico
usage: Invitations handed out by an anonymous figure at Carnevale. You can exchange them for generous gifts at any Fiera delle Meraviglie Notturne. Relax, once people see the invitation, you will receive a warm welcome.
description: The anonymous sender calls themselves 'Il Signore del Carnevale'. It is unclear if this title is a threat or in jest. The dark red soaking the paper isn't blood, but rather a fragrant wine, which seems to say that this invitation was born alongside Carnevale itself.
obtain: Event Stage drop, Event mission reward

name: Stronghold Credits
usage: Can be exchanged for all sorts of supplies in Stronghold Protocol.
description: Medals prepared by Rhodes Island's workshop for operators participating in Stronghold Protocol. Magnetic. Apparently, if you gather enough of them, you can make a fortress out of chess pieces.
obtain: Event Stage drop, Event mission reward

name: Multi-functional Snow Detector
usage: Multi-functional survey equipment scattered throughout the snow from the avalanches. Please return it to the observation station when found, and the staff will express their gratitude with practical supplies.
description: A survey instrument developed by Rhine Lab specifically for use in Kjerag to collect various data from the mysterious snowy realm, maintaining stable functionality even in low-temperature environments. 'Myths are merely unexplained realities, and science will one day snatch off their veils.'—Elena firmly believes in this.

name: Trial EXP
usage: Experience gained from finished trials. Upgrades trial levels.
description: Right and wrong are far from crucial in a simulation. They are only a form of support. They help you make the correct choices when the battle is real.
obtain: Event Stage drop, Event mission reward

name: Data Blackbox
usage: Used to perform Data Iteration on Limiter Units.
description: An encrypted data block. Always remember, the conversion of information often entails unavoidable wear. Make good use of your information storage devices, but do not depend on them.

name: Dr Oxygen
usage: An innovative beverage inspired by high-altitude air-supply devices, now the lifeblood of Columbians. No one would refuse to fork over a high price to taste a new era beyond the Starpod.
description: It's just cheap sugar water based on Forte Energy Drinks' flavoring? Who cares! Nowadays, you only hear such boring truths from bitter and bankrupt companies that didn't think of bottling their beverages in rocket-shaped containers.

name: Saltfin Garum
usage: Both the daily drink of the pirates of the Salt Flat, and a currency they accept. So long as the fleet lacks priceless treasures such as rum, it will never be replaced.
description: Beverage made from chopped saltfin viscera and fermented with microorganisms from the underground rivers beneath the Salt Flat. The stench is both invigorating and tear-inducing. And as for its other properties... 'Has anyone told that idiota in the kitchen that you don't need to add any goddamn salt to a saltfin?!'
obtain: Event Stage drop, Event mission reward

name: 'Yum-yum!'
usage: Don't be stingy when it comes to complimenting how the food smells at Savors at Yu's. Once the Young Chef's ears go red from praise, he'll discreetly add a few extra bits of meat to your plate.
description: Fragrant meals fear not alleys deep. While invisible to the eye on most days, there is a faint aroma lining the streets, at least until it hits you face-first in front of the restaurant it leads to. You need only follow the scent of food to paint a grand picture of Baizao's streets.
obtain: Event Stage drop, Event mission reward

name: 'Strategist' Point
usage: Can be exchanged for the corresponding event stage reward.
description: Rhodes Island issues special reward points as an incentive to field operators contributing to Integrated Strategies operations. These points can be used to redeem important supplies.

name: Ostracon
usage: An essential item for Athenian citizens when voting. But what to do with used ostraca? Astynomos' Office decided to collect and wrap them up nicely for tourist souvenirs, and this innovative idea was well received by all.
description: Even though everyone has a terminal loaded with all kinds of apps these days, the Minoans still prefer to follow their ancient traditions.

name: Broken Originium Lamp
usage: A damaged Originium lamp found in the Dark Woods. Once Na Saoirsí's supply issues were resolved, the citizens spontaneously decided to organize, taking out the only supplies they had on hand to recover these relics of the war.
description: One tradition Tarans brought back is wearing an Originium lamp at their hips. Once, people would take them into the Dark Woods, but now those bodies have been scattered by the wind. Not even shadows are left, only shattered lamps.
obtain: Event Stage drop, Event mission reward

name: Looseleaf/Rhodes Fashion Review
usage: A themed Fashion Collections set containing a Custom Looseleaf and stickers, easily placed and displayed.
description: Create your own unique style.

name: Looseleaf/Media
usage: A themed Fashion Collections set containing a Custom Looseleaf and stickers, easily placed and displayed.
description: A new melody composed for today's display.

name: Sticker Pack/Crimson Solitaire
usage: Special Looseleaf Stickers for Fashion Collections usable as decorations.
description: A grand encompassing performance.
obtain: Complete Crimson Solitaire Themed Set to obtain

name: Sticker Pack/Caerula Arbor
usage: Special Looseleaf Stickers for Fashion Collections usable as decorations.
description: The tides call out for you to travel.
obtain: Complete Caerula Arbor Themed Set to obtain

name: Sticker Pack/Silverfrost Frontier
usage: Special Looseleaf Stickers for Fashion Collections usable as decorations.
description: Seek the beauty of mystery in the bitter cold.
obtain: Complete Silverfrost Frontier Themed Set to obtain

name: Sticker Pack/Furnaceside Fables
usage: Special Looseleaf Stickers for Fashion Collections usable as decorations.
description: The land witnesses the Sarkaz's splendid forms.
obtain: Complete Furnaceside Fables Themed Set to obtain

name: Sticker Pack/Garden of Grotesqueries
usage: Special Looseleaf Stickers for Fashion Collections usable as decorations.
description: Tourists entranced by enchanting landscapes.
obtain: Complete Garden of Grotesqueries Themed Set to obtain

name: Sticker Pack/Tales Within the Sand
usage: Special Looseleaf Stickers for Fashion Collections usable as decorations.
description: Admire the artistic mesh of desert and oasis.
obtain: Complete Tales Within the Sand Themed Set to obtain

name: Draft of History
usage: A history manuscript yet to be approved. Hand it to a certain Magistrate of Water, and she will gladly offer you excess supplies from the Sky Mirror Pavilion. Once compiled, It will transcend its era, endure the test of time, and be judged before becoming time itself.
description: A chronicle of an event's beginning and end, an examination of an era's gains and losses, an analysis of one's rights and wrongs, to be settled with a single verdict.

name: Stronghold Credits
usage: Can be exchanged for all sorts of supplies in Stronghold Protocol.
description: Medals prepared by Rhodes Island's workshop for operators participating in Stronghold Protocol. Magnetic. Apparently, if you gather enough of them, you can make a fortress out of chess pieces.
obtain: Event Stage drop, Event mission reward

name: Cork Stopper
usage: The cork stoppers Golden Prairie uses for red wine intended for the Nuova Volsiniese market, with a special seal stuck on top. Collect enough and exchange them at the Red Wine Championship Commission reception counter for prizes (such as tickets to watch the championship).
description: The big prizes demand far too many corks in exchange. The vast majority will trade in for a few mismatched tasting wineglasses at best. It is a blatantly Kazimierzian marketing ploy, but that has not deterred Golden Prairie from relying on it to open up the Nuova Volsiniese market.

name: Broken Verses
usage: Scraps of unsent letters. Those who find these can choose to either preserve them as evidence, or toss them to the still-burning bonfire in exchange for a pittance of warmth.
description: 'To all who have held onto their tomorrows, I bestow what life and hope remain in me to every soul who seeks freedom and happiness. I will be dead before morning light... Mama, I call out your name, and you are Ursus, yet who am I?'

name: Originite Prime
usage: Dangerous but necessary, this precious material is widely used across many fields.
description: Widely used in industry, this Originium crystal is difficult to extract. Its production requires very fine processing, but it remains the major energy source of the world and the foundation of Originium Arts. Even if widespread rumors claim 'Originite Prime spreads an incurable disease,' few can resist its temptation.

name: Orundum
usage: An artificial material commonly used to recruit operators.
description: Made from Originite Prime, it also contains other minerals. In the past, it was used only as a conductive element, but it has since become a store of credit value.

name: Originium Shard
usage: An Originium shard collected from polluted regions. Can be used to produce Orundum.
description: An Originium shard collected from heavily contaminated regions. Anyone who touches it has a high chance to get infected and even mutate. Therefore, it is a hazardous material as indicated in the Columbia CDC toxicity database.

name: Universal Certificates
usage: A certificate that attests an operator possesses core abilities. Can be exchanged for rare materials.
description: Time has allowed these operators to gain a deep understanding of Rhodes Island's affairs. They will provide you the rare resources you need.

name: LMD
usage: A widely used currency issued by Lungmen.
description: Since the financial crisis, economic decline and political instability have stood in the way of trade. The widespread circulation of Lungmen Dollars has allowed for some recovery in the business world.

name: Pure Gold
usage: A refined gold bar. Can be exchanged for a lot of LMD.
description: How much ore does it take to make such valuable gold bars? It doesn't matter. What matters is that they're yours.

name: Distinction Certificate
usage: A certificate that attests to an operator's distinguished accomplishments and expertise. Can be exchanged for rare items.
description: The Infection Isolation Act is the last vestige of modern nation states. As long as you have some special ability, it is but a meaningless piece of paper. (The words of her Leithanian mentor.)

name: Commendation Certificate
usage: A certificate that attests to an operator's skills and qualifications. Can be exchanged for items.
description: Good help is hard to find in troubled times, especially when trying to do it secretly. It's like finding a needle in a haystack, but what if Rhodes Island were to become the haystack? Would that save some time?

name: Purchase Certificate
usage: A certificate describing the business and operational capacities of Rhodes Island. Can be exchanged for items.
description: The operations at Rhodes Island require substantial funding and a variety of materials. Therefore, we must trade in diverse markets in order to keep everything running

description: A long-term, stable relationship with the headhunting agency can effectively control our expenditures. However, we hope that this method will not be required every time.

description: The fact that the headhunting agency has taken this consideration proves its sincerity. A word of warning though - if you seek to exploit this method for profit, I'm afraid the consequences will far outweigh any gains.
obtain: Automatically obtained when Headhunting Data expires

name: Intelligence Certificate
usage: A reward for reviewing past events; Can be used to exchange for various supplies.
description: In order to encourage Operators to proactively replay and review past events, upper management decided to initiate long-term activities that would grant a voucher for replaying prior operations. The voucher can be taken to the HR Department to exchange for various supplies, and the designated events are randomly selected by the system.

name: Contract Bounty
usage: Rewards earned after completing a contract. Can be used to redeem supplies.
description: The ruthless but effective bounty mechanism is the only way to ensure the normal operations of the Contingency Contract system.

name: Crystal Contract Bounty
usage: Rewards earned after completing a contract. Can be used to redeem supplies.
description: The ruthless but effective bounty mechanism is the only way to ensure the normal operations of the Contingency Contract system.

name: Information Fragments
usage: A topological model of effective intelligence that can be used to reconstruct past events.
description:
An auxiliary function of Rhodes Island's intelligence processing system. After extracting effective intelligence from a complex batch of information, the system was able to recreate images of past events with astonishing fidelity.
The information was packaged as videotapes to make it easier for ordinary people to understand.

name: Dull Originium
usage: A piece of deactivated Originium that no longer has any practical value, even if it is polished into the shape of an Originite Prime.
description: Once, they said it was the origin of suffering. Now, they say its disappearance was the beginning of tragedy.

name: Ownerless Mining Lamp
usage: An abandoned mining lamp that still works, though the name tag has been torn off.
description: People speculate as to who its master was. It has been passed from one person to another, carrying more and more stories, the culmination of the miners' lives.

name: Altered Flag
usage: The flag of Ursus with the mark of Reunion painted over it. Defacing the national flag is punishable by death according to the Flag Law of Ursus.
description: The nobles of Grypherburg see this symbol as a grave threat, but it was from their hubris that it came about in the first place.

name: Unexploded Dud
usage: An unexploded dud. It must be handed over to relevant authorities once disarmed and disassembled.
description: The corruption of the empire may not have begun with Grypherburg, but its decline surely started with a dud from Tulskaya.

usage: A large dose of concentrated emergency supplement used to maintain Sanity. New active ingredients, same instant results. Possible side effect: disruption of biological clock. Please read carefully before administering.
description: This product's effectiveness has been boosted to a degree thanks to modern concentrative technologies. By no means should it be used as medication. When the situation is so dire that you need it to restore Sanity, you won't have the time to read this. Good luck!

name: Full Color
usage: A flaky mooncake filled with perky sweet ground meat. Can be used to restore Sanity.
description: A crisp, flaky mooncake in golden brown, liable to stir anyone's appetite.

name: Full Moon
usage: A flaky mooncake filled with frankincense Yunnan ham. Can be used to restore Sanity.
description: A crisp, flaky mooncake in golden brown, liable to stir anyone's appetite.

name: Smiley Face
usage: A glazed mooncake filled with rose red bean paste. Can be used to restore Sanity.
description: A tender, sugary mooncake with a glossy sheen, prone to making anyone drool at the mouth.

name: Osmanthus
usage: A glazed mooncake filled with spicy and salty nuts. Can be used to restore Sanity.
description: A tender, sugary mooncake with a glossy sheen, prone to making anyone drool at the mouth.

name: 'Radiant Courtyard'
usage: A snowskin mooncake filled with mango and shredded coconut. Can be used to restore Sanity.
description: A tasty and refreshing snowskin mooncake. Remember to properly refrigerate!

usage: A snowskin mooncake filled with meat floss. Can be used to restore Sanity.
description: A tasty and refreshing snowskin mooncake. Remember to properly refrigerate!

usage: A glazed mooncake filled with bean paste and sweet osmanthus. Can be used to restore Sanity.
description: A sweet and crisp glazed mooncake. Remember to heat prior to consumption!

name: 'Shrouded Golden Waves'
usage: A glazed mooncake filled with salted egg yolk. Can be used to restore Sanity.
description: A sweet and crisp glazed mooncake. Remember to heat prior to consumption!

name: 'Lunar Joy'
usage: A crystal mooncake filled with mango pomelo sago. Can be used to restore Sanity.
description: Mooncake with a tempting crystal-clear outer layer. Keep refrigerated.

name: 'Autumn Jade'
usage: A crystal mooncake filled with seaweed and meat floss. Can be used to restore Sanity.
description: Mooncake with a tempting crystal-clear outer layer. Keep refrigerated.

name: 'Golden Charm'
usage: A glazed mooncake filled with custard. Can be used to restore Sanity.
description: A sweet and crisp glazed mooncake. Remember to heat prior to consumption!

name: 'Autumn's Eve'
usage: A glazed mooncake filled with dried Yanese mustard and meat. Can be used to restore Sanity.
description: A sweet and crisp glazed mooncake. Remember to heat prior to consumption!

name: Amiya's Birthday Cake
usage: A piece of cake gifted by Amiya. Can be used to restore Sanity.
description: Looking at the exquisite and cute little cake, you can imagine Amiya's brilliant smile on this day full of love.

name: Mystery Jellybeans
usage: An elaborately packaged pack of candies, with some strange flavors hidden within. Can be used to restore Sanity.
description: 'It's not just sugar! There are all sorts of flavors, so try them all and find your favorite!'

name: Multiherb Brew
usage: A bottled concentrate of eight herbs. Can be used to restore Sanity.
description: A drink from Hoshiguma, meticulously brewed over a long time. Just the aroma alone is enough to invigorate your spirits, as if flowers and trees suddenly sprang up around you, inviting you into a sweet dream.

name: Cold-Chain Snow Fin
usage: A box of top-grade snow fins from Mount Karlan. Can be used to restore Sanity.
description: Kjerag's flavors perfectly preserved in this small icebox. Who says the snow and wind of Mount Karlan can't be cherished off the mountain?

name: Black-White Taro Cake
usage: A pastry made with glutinous rice and taro paste. Can be used to restore Sanity.
description: Heaven and earth encapsulated with Wang's sentiments, all contained in this tiny taro-flavored universe.

name: Handmade Tea Bags
usage: An individually-packaged box of floral tea. Can be used to restore Sanity.
description: Made with lavender, marigold, and a tiny bit of honey, this relaxing, smooth, and refreshing tea blend was specially prepared for you by Amiya after much research.

name: Top Emergency Sanity Potion
usage: A large dose of emergency supplement that will swiftly clear your mind. Possible side effect: migraine.
description: It contains a small amount of mustard extract, so please keep it away from your eyes (other instructions omitted). When the situation is so dire that you need to use it to restore Sanity, you won't have the time to read this. Good luck!

name: Vegetable Radish Tin
usage: A dish from an Operator's hometown. Can be used to restore Sanity.
description: The tinned food Kroos often eats on field missions. Worried it won't suit you, she's sprinkled some salt in it just for you.

name: Frozen Kung Pao Diced Fowlbeast
usage: A dish from an Operator's hometown. Can be used to restore Sanity.
description: Waai Fu is hardly good at cooking, but she can handle heating up some frozen food.

name: Karlan Chargrill Barbecue Ribs with Truffle Paste
usage: A dish from an Operator's hometown. Can be used to restore Sanity.
description: Victorian condiments paired with immortalized Kjerag ways. The taste of the ribs is fine beyond words.

name: Edible Cubes
usage: A crystallization of science. Can be used to restore Sanity.
description: Kal'tsit saw to it the cubes before you have both nutrition and flavor, but you still can't tell how these were made.

name: Rim Billiton Watermelon Cake
usage: A dish from Amiya's hometown. Can be used to restore Sanity.
description: Times of reunion call for getting together and eating sweet, sweet stuff. Do you need her to feed you?

name: Persimmons Picked from a Scroll
usage: Two persimmons of excessively perfect appearance. Can be used to restore Sanity.
description: Able to see them, and feel them, you're convinced you could even taste how sweet they are, even though you know they're naught but droplets of ink drawn from Dusk's scrolls.

name: Pure Floral Dew
usage: A crystal-clear beverage. Can be used to restore Sanity.
description: Muelsyse claims she bought it just before meeting up with you, but the bottle looks pristinely label-free.

name: Furnace Fried Rice
usage: A bowl of fried rice you can't find anywhere else in Kazdel. Can be used to restore Sanity.
description: A 'gift' from Wiš'adel. Be careful: she's not that kind-hearted.

name: Emergency Sanity Potion
usage: An emergency supplement used to maintain Sanity and keep your mind clear.
description: Although overeating can relieve the anxiety and pressure accumulated on the battlefield, it's not a healthy lifestyle, Doctor. This supplement contains quite a bit of sugar, but the packing is specially designed to be hard to open. Treat it as a kind of exercise and burn some calories.

name: Emergency Sanity Booster
usage: An emergency supplement with lightly increased dosage, used to maintain Sanity. Keep your mind clear and drive out fatigue.
description: Although overeating can relieve the anxiety and pressure accumulated on the battlefield, it's not a healthy lifestyle, Doctor. This supplement contains quite a bit of sugar, but the packing is specially designed to be hard to open. Treat it as a kind of exercise and burn some calories.

name: Crisp Walnut Cookies
usage: A box of handmade snacks, traditionally packaged. Can be used to restore Sanity.
description: Lee knows how people love to stuff themselves full at the table on days of reunion, so he saves his craft just for dim sum that stores well.

name: Volcanic Lava Cake
usage: A handmade cake with a few recipe tweaks to fit the holiday spirit. Can be used to restore Sanity.
description: The one dessert Eyjafjalla knows how to make. Catering to the festive atmosphere, she made some very special adjustments to the ingredients.

name: Royal Lotus Biscuits
usage: Delicate royal pastries provided by a padishah of Sargon. Can be used to restore Sanity.
description: Made from the finest of ingredients and exquisitely decorated, like a work of art on the table. Seeing it reminds you that Pepe really is heaven-blessed.

name: Emergency Sanity Sampler
usage: A portable, easy-to-carry sampler that is good for maintaining a level of Sanity during emergencies.
description: A low-dosage sample. To be used rationally and sensibly. If you are satisfied with this product's efficacy, you may also be interested in our other packages.
obtain: Obtained through event stage limited-time drop or event

name: Spicy Hotpot(?)
usage: A soup base and ingredients, placed in a smelting basin. Can be used to restore Sanity.
description: Nian's ingredients are all chosen to her greatest likings. The extremely simply forged bronzeware is also compliments of the chef (i.e. her). Is this really meant for domestic stewing?

name: Pastoral Afternoon Tea Pastries
usage: A treat from an Operator's hometown. Can be used to restore Sanity.
description: Teatime refreshments courtesy of Viviana. The poem may be sweet as honey, but sometimes a little pastry can't be beat.

name: Saluzzo Vintage
usage: A fine bottle of wine from the Saluzzo winery, 40 years aged. Can be used to restore Sanity.
description: Apparently this is the most precious bottle from Alberto's wine cellar. Of course, he never said you could have it, but what does that matter?

name: Golden Syrup New Year's Cake
usage: A Yanese snack with golden luster. Can be used to restore Sanity.
description: Mr. Nothing's never revealed the recipe he uses for New Year cakes. Perhaps plain, ordinary, and sweet is the flavor that most suits the holiday.

name: Glassy-Sweet Rice Fritters
usage: A Yanese-style dim sum so sugary you can taste it just by looking. Can be used to restore Sanity.
description: Traditionally flavored Yanese dim sum Zuo Le specially brought from Yumen. That sweet scent just slaps you in the face the moment you unwrap them.

name: House Special Misandao
usage: A popular Baizao street food. Can be used to restore Sanity.
description: Quality street food Yu made just for you. Sweet and chewy, with an unforgettable taste.

name: Papaya Leaf Meat Pie
usage: A portion of meat pies with ingredients added to personal taste. Can be used to restore Sanity.
description: With the encouragement of Yanese Operators in the kitchen, Amiya has added a leafy vegetable to her own meat pie filling. She's tried it herself, and she hopes you'll like it too.

name: Custard Creams
usage: A homestyle snack from an Operator's hometown. Can be used to restore Sanity.
description: In the most ordinary foods dwells the most heartfelt care. Popping open the bag for a bite never fails to bring Amiya's considerate nature to mind.

name: 'Rhodes Island'
usage: An elegant and delicate cake. Can be used to restore Sanity.
description: Who do you think of when you see this cake?

name: 'Floating Silver'
usage: A snow skin mooncake filled with dark chocolate and almond ice cream. Can be used to restore Sanity.
description: A tasty and refreshing snowskin mooncake. Remember to properly refrigerate!

name: 'Lucent Night'
usage: A snow skin mooncake filled with a five-nut mix. Can be used to restore Sanity.
description: A tasty and refreshing snowskin mooncake. Remember to properly refrigerate!

name: 'Moonchart Osmanthus'
usage: A flaky mooncake filled with chestnut custard. Can be used to restore Sanity.
description: A crisp, flaky mooncake in golden brown, liable to stir anyone's appetite.

name: 'Glimmering Dream'
usage: A flaky mooncake filled with minced pork and pickles. Can be used to restore Sanity.
description: A crisp, flaky mooncake in golden brown, liable to stir anyone's appetite.

name: Amiya's Birthday Cake
usage: A piece of cake gifted by Amiya. Can be used to restore Sanity.
description: This cake is nothing special in terms of appearance or taste. Its entire significance lies in this special day filled with love, and the little birthday girl who presented it to you.

name: 1101 Birthday Cake
usage: A delicate little cake. Can be used to restore Sanity.
description: It's hard to imagine Kal'tsit making a dessert like this, and even harder to imagine her admitting it without batting an eyelid.

name: Extremely Filling Dessert Platter
usage: The magnum opus of Exusiai's career as a patissier, an incredibly rich dessert platter. Can be used to restore Sanity.
description: It wasn't easy sending a heaping platter of desserts from Laterano to Rhodes Island, but in the spirit of 'Penguin Logistics, Guaranteed Success' Exusiai thought of a way to get it done. Aside from being a little squished, the cakes look fresh out the oven.

name: Regular Tasks Proxy Card
usage: A card granting load distribution privileges for PRTS. Once activated, allows PRTS to conduct Annihilation and Stationary Security Service battles as your proxy.
description: Based on a massive volume of live combat records, PRTS can perfectly replicate your tactics to conduct Annihilation and Stationary Security Service missions by proxy, using actuarial data processing, logic training, and scenario simulation. You're spared even the need to pay it your full attention.

name: Logistics Special Permit
usage: When the Logistics Special Permit is used, operations consume no Sanity and the normal Regular Drops are changed to Guaranteed Drops with 3x quantity.
description: A Logistics Special Permit issued by Rhodes Island to ensure the successful execution of emergency dispatches, owing to ever-increasing activity on the battlefield. With this, operators may request top priority support from Logistics via PRTS. Logistics operators will prioritize delivering extra supplies and assist in locating nearby resources.

name: Premium Material Voucher
usage: A special exchange voucher issued by the Rhodes Island Procurement Department. Can be used within a limited time to obtain premium elite materials.
description: In order to address scarcities of certain materials during processing, the Procurement Department has issued exchange vouchers for operators' discretionary use, granting access to the materials needed.

name: Advanced Material Voucher
usage: A special exchange voucher issued by the Rhodes Island Procurement Department. Can be used within a limited time to obtain advanced elite materials.
description: In order to address scarcities of certain materials during processing, the Procurement Department has issued exchange vouchers for operators' discretionary use, granting access to the materials needed.

name: Ten-roll Headhunting Permit
usage: A permit issued by the Human Resource Department of Rhodes Island. Can be used to recruit 10 Operators at a time through headhunting companies.
description: When Rhodes Island is need of skilled operators, our normal permits may not make efficient use of our headhunting company contractors. In order to accelerate the development of Rhodes Island, the Human Resource Department has issued these permits for headhunting in batches.

name: Ten-roll Kernel Headhunting Permit
usage: A special permit from Rhodes Island HR distribution for recruiting multiple kernel talents. Can be used to recruit ten operators.
description: Rhodes Island's expansion is inseparable from the help and support it has received from kernel personnel. These headhunting items will assist the Doctor in recruiting talent within specified bounds.

name: Awakening Commemoration Permit
usage: A batch headhunting permit issued by the Rhodes Island HR Department; Can be used at a certain time to recruit talented Operators, 10 rolls at once.
description: In order to ensure the available talent pool can be scaled upwards to satisfy the Doctor's emergency preparation request, this batch of headhunting items carries specificity, time-sensitivity, and of course, a degree of risk.

description: Rhodes Island purchases and stores boxes of supplies from various places. However, due to the lack of an organized storage system, each box contains seemingly random materials.

name: Rhodes Island Supplies IX
usage: Filled with an assortment of supplies and materials.
description: Rhodes Island purchases and stores boxes of supplies from various places. However, due to the lack of an organized storage system, each box contains seemingly random materials.
